own_solution.law: Doppler effect, moving source, stationary observer in still air: f' = f c/(c - vs)
assumptions: source approaching directly at constant speed

defect_reasons.other: T8B99 ('tuned up soon after the tone begins') does not say explicitly that the listening occurs after the retuning, whereas TD410 does; the natural reading supports the R answer.

notes: Checked: base 440*343/323 = 467.245; R answers 449*343/323 = 476.802, 456*343/323 = 484.235, 464*343/323 = 492.731. Cancellation expression reduces to t2 - t1 = (c - vs)/(f c), so d cancels; correct. D claims hold (violin is a separate source; earlier run precedes the switch-on that fixes 440 Hz). Minimal pairs T5688/T8B99 and TEE83/TD410 share 16 Hz and differ only in attachment; TE5DD/T4EE7 share 300 m. TEDCB and T62DC are declared numeral-free twins, which resolves my pass-1 concern.
